name: Website Structure & Navigation Mapper API
shortDescription: Turn a crawl manifest into a navigation graph.
description: Deterministic website structure and navigation mapper that turns a crawl manifest (pages with their outbound links, plus an optional sitemap) into an internal navigation graph: click depth from the home page, in/out degree, page roles (home/hub/orphan/dead_end), top-level sections, unreachable pages, dangling internal links, and a sitemap diff. No fetching, no LLM, nothing stored.

name: Web Scraper Test Suite & Validator API
shortDescription: Assert scraper selectors against sample HTML.
description: Deterministic web-scraper test suite. Parses a supplied HTML snapshot with a real HTML parser (cheerio) and runs selector assertions (exists, count, equals, contains, matches, non_empty, optionally on an attribute), returning per-test pass/fail, extracted values, an overall score and grade. Use it to verify a scraper's selectors still extract what they should. No fetching, no LLM, nothing stored.

name: Scraped Data Quality Scorer API
shortDescription: Score the quality of scraped/extracted datasets.
description: Deterministic quality scorer for scraped and extracted datasets. Scores extraction completeness, duplicate extraction, HTML/whitespace noise, placeholder/boilerplate values, and per-column type consistency into a 0-100 score with per-dimension subscores, a per-field breakdown, and issues. Schema-free (no reference schema required), no fetching, no LLM, nothing stored.
